title: Turning on bulk mode scrolls a right-scrolled table back so the checkbox column is in view
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Window 1024 px wide so the Inventory table scrolls horizontally (if it does not, tick more columns in Column Selection). DevTools Elements panel available to measure the column.
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory (Active tab) scroll the table horizontally to its right edge.
  2. Open the ⋮ actions menu and pick Deactivate parts.
  3. Inspect the checkbox column, then tick the first row's checkbox.
  4. Scroll the table right again and click the bulk bar's X (button_bulk_close_selection).
  5. Click the Inactive tab, scroll the table to its right edge, then pick ⋮ > Activate parts.
custom_expected:
1. Part Number and the first columns are scrolled out of view.
  2. The table scrolls back to its left edge; the checkbox column (checkbox_select_all_inventory in the header, checkbox_select_inventory_part_{id} on each row) is in view without scrolling; the bar shows text_bulk_selection_count "0 selected" and button_bulk_deactivate_parts blue and disabled.
  3. The column is 44 px wide at the left of the table; the row ticks and the bar reads "1 selected".
  4. The mode ends, the ticks clear and the checkbox column is gone.
  5. The table scrolls back to its left edge with the checkbox column in view; the bar shows Activate (button_bulk_activate_parts) blue and disabled.
